name: Carbon Based Menu Search
author: carbonbasedstudio

sections.description:
Carbon Based Menu Search adds a search icon to the menus you choose. Click it to open a full-width search bar.

Features

  • Inline SVG icon – Default search icon, with no Font Awesome required.
  • Other icon sets – Optional Dashicons or Font Awesome icon classes.
  • Menu targeting – Target menus by registered menu, manual ID/slug, or menu CSS class.
  • Insert position – Insert search at the start, the end, or after the Nth top-level item.
  • What it searches – Search the whole site, posts and pages, WooCommerce products, or selected post types.
  • Panel behaviour – Optional close control on the open panel, and an optional Ctrl/Cmd+K shortcut.
  • Appearance – Colours, panel background image (with position), animation, z-index, and custom CSS.
  • Placement outside menus – Shortcode [cbsms_search_toggle] and a Menu Search Toggle block.

Settings are under Carbon Based > Menu Search.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the carbon-based-menu-search folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate Carbon Based Menu Search.
  3. Open Carbon Based > Menu Search, tick at least one Registered menu, and save.
sections.faq:
Who is this for?

  • Sites that want search in a classic WordPress menu.
  • Stores that want to search products, posts, or the whole site from that menu.
  • Themes that need a shortcode or block when the menu is not a classic menu.

User guide

Setup and menu placement are covered in the Menu Search user guide.
